trackerLog.subject: Asteria

feature.title: World Cannon as industrial superweapon
feature.notes: User reject of current vertical plate: barrel scale is too small and the stone language is still not Fallen. Required look is FF16 Fallen — pale smooth unlit cyclopean blocks, city-to-mountain terrace scale, no window glow. Constium iron is a later collar, not the main mass. Barrel stays vertical / spaceward. Who it is built to hit stays open; Vortan still names Fire as the public target. Firing still unseals Nyxara. Not adjacent to Temple of Fire. New scale/style plate is the next art pass.

Layout sheet accepted (https://i.imgur.com/mCfISje.jpeg). Rendered plates do not match that layout and are not the consistency spec. Block from the accepted sheet: central open dome / rain-well, west meditation pavilion, east reception pavilion, terrace of circular tide-pools, stairs to Queen's Cove, Undertow Sigil chamber in the cliff. Overcast readable materials. Caustic light is not a shippable material. Sigil: Undertow.

No-cannon mood plate accepted. Layout / consistency sketch still required. North volcanic highland, not next to the World Cannon. Aspect: heat, forge, Nyxara leak. Corruption is Nyxara speaking through prayer. Sigil: Cinder.

Peninsula concept accepted. Temple of Life sits at the end of a long peninsula, same massing idea as Temple of Light, with substantially more greenery and trees. South of King's Sea above Tierso. Aspect: crops, birth, field healing, blight. Sigil: Root.

trackerLog.decision: FEAT-023 accepted plan is the layout sheet only. Renders stay tone until they match that plan.
FEAT-025 peninsula plate accepted. FEAT-024 no-cannon mood accepted; needs a layout sheet. FEAT-004 current plates rejected for scale and Fallen language.
